title: Building the shooter
summary: Constants, the roller, getIos, and registering it.

steps.title: Open ShooterConstants.java
steps.say: Numbers first. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterConstants` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find ROLLER_MOTOR_CONFIG
steps.say: Every number about the shooter lives in one file. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `ROLLER_MOTOR_CONFIG` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Open ShooterSubsystem.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find RollerMech
steps.say: Build the second mechanism. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `RollerMech` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: create the roller the same way

steps.title: The roller
steps.say: Create the roller like the flywheel just above it.

target.text: create the roller the same way

steps.title: getIos
steps.say: MWLib only runs the mechanisms you list here. Forget one and it never moves.

steps.title: Open RobotContainer.java
steps.say: The step everyone forgets. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `RobotContainer` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `register the ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find register the ShooterSubsystem with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Register it
steps.say: Add the shooter here, like the drivetrain above. Without this, the shooter never runs.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Spin it up
steps.say: Hold **U** (right bumper). In AdvantageScope, search for `FlywheelVelocity`, then drag **Subsystem/Shooter/FlywheelVelocity** onto the **Left Axis**.
